question: Does an early paid precursor option create any reproducible task region where conditional transient neurogenesis repays the total option, development, activity, damage, and opportunity cost?

development_boundary_assay.purpose: measure the minimum early option fraction that physically permits a two-cell organ before substrate depletion; not a holdout performance claim

stable_safety.gate: zero conditional preparedness investments and zero neural developments in all 12 runs

holdout.success_gate: conditional must have positive mean margin-AUC difference and at least 4/6 positive pairs versus every listed control
holdout.engineering_gate: all runs finite and absolute material residual below 3.0e-5

negative_release_rule: If no preregistered region passes, release 0.6.4 as a negative boundary result and set the conditional preparedness/neurogenesis grammar dormant by default for the next milestone rather than tuning on holdout seeds.
claims_excluded: statistical generalisation beyond the registered digital assays
